title: [Lean] Count fixed-width marked binary increment and overflow
body:
Explicit author-checked contextual kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. This reusable component does not change the selected exponent or establish the full multiplication theorem.

## Completed checked chunk

MarkedBinaryIncrement refines the credited PR64 RippleCounter into the marked sequential one-bit tape used by the public arithmetic/input routines. It executes entrance, carry propagation and rewind, returning to the left marker. For every supplied width w, including zero, it proves exact first halt 2*carryLength+3 <= 2w+3 and at most w+2 represented cells at every prefix, including both markers. Actual output satisfies value(updated)+overflow*2^w=value(input)+1. The old flag is overwritten.

Finite coverage: arbitrary finite words at every width; no selected-input census.

Conditional-interface coverage: exact unchanged-width p+1 requires value(input)+1<2^w. The controller reports actual overflow without a free allocated high bit. Supplied marked input, private tape and exterior blanks remain explicit.

Full-theorem coverage: no physical initialization/allocation implementation, general multitape-to-single-tape simulation, dirty-state inverse, selected recursive cost family or full integer multiplication/runtime bound. Later paid widening and adder composition are deliberately outside this closed chunk.

## Reuse, evidence and reproducibility

Seven changed files, three exact accepted sources totaling 36,714 bytes. TapeStack preserves all declarations and proof bodies from PR64 while narrowing its broad tactic import to exact providers. CounterArithmetic changes one underflow proof to name Nat.mul_eq_zero after narrowing imports; definitions, statements and increment proof are unchanged. MarkedBinaryIncrement is the new marked-layout refinement, not a claim of inventing ripple counting. Original attributions are retained; new refinement James Chang with OpenAI assistance, Apache-2.0.

Five unchanged modules from immutable PR1840, PR1869 and rfu08 PR64 heads are reused without copying. All three included sources have fresh local kernel checks and independent source/API/terminal review; ACCEPTANCE.json records 55 complete standard-axiom probes, printed types and diagnostics. REPRODUCE.md contains isolated instructions for an existing Lean 4.21.0 and pinned Mathlib installation. No pre-publication compiler or CI replay was performed; post-submission CI is separate.

Candidate parent: 94e50883325b387add6891258a986f797b09cacc. Directly checked later selected-source context at 01a65937ece11b56d515c81f039464ae3043c1c1 retains the same kappa and five critical scientific inputs. The complete subsequent 01a659-to-511223 diff changes only pre-existing contributor/docs/audit records and adds unrelated packages; no accepted source rebuild is required.

Bounded overlap comparison: PR64 supplies counter semantics; PR1840/1869 supply the public tape/marked alphabet APIs. Exact new module searches found no duplicate PR. This chunk supplies their counted marked-controller refinement; it makes no global novelty claim.

Submission context: all five critical inputs freshly match at dad0d9b438820ff934d15ee716b4e54fabb3bfb1; exact fork head 6669fc921f25e74b1b32d499f75c05af7307b76b.
